## A Full Day of Mathematics {.section-title}

The 2026 program brings together undergraduate data analysis, career exploration, and an invited lecture on statistical thinking in the AI era. Students may participate in individual events or spend the day engaging with the broader mathematics community.

[See the complete 2026 program →](events-2026.html)
